title: Heating Control
summary: A microcontroller-connected heating controller with temperature monitoring and historical charts.
content:
This project connects a custom heating controller to an app through a web server and microcontroller.

Temperature-driven control

The system monitors temperatures on the roof and in the basement, with an additional sensor in the tank. A configured temperature difference triggers a relay controlling the hot-water pump.

Making measurements visible

The app displays temperature history across different time ranges, from recent minutes to longer-term trends. This is a description of a personal electronics project, not a claim of certified safety or suitability for other heating installations.
